rationale: Converted each scenario wind speed to corrected speed v_c = v*(rho/1.225)^(1/3), applied the cubic power curve for 8 x 2.5 MW turbines (rated 20 MW, cut-in 3, rated 12, cut-out 25 m/s), then computed p10/p50/p90 per timestamp via linear-interpolated quantiles at pos=q*(n-1). average_interval_width_mw is the mean of (p90-p10) across t01-t03.
